interface.longDescription: Settle turns group indecision into a done deal. Create a poll with 2-6 options, share a single link, and up to 10 friends vote yes/no/maybe on each option — no app install required. Polls close automatically when the deadline hits. Check results any time to see where the group stands.

name: settle-group-decisions
description: Create a quick group vote. Share one link, everyone votes on the web, no app needed. Settles automatically.
